## Description

Six sites per tooth: pocket depth, recession, bleeding on probing, plaque; mobility and furcation per tooth; comparison with the last chart.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A dentist can record a full chart by keyboard in one pass.
- [ ] **AC2.** Two charts can be compared side by side with changes in words.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
